verdict.rationale: Stagehand's docs describe an official integration that gives a Claude Code agent persistent Stagehand browser tools over MCP/stdio, with one server process exposing `run`, `snapshot` and `screenshot` tools. There is also a dedicated MCP integration section, and the team says its Stagehand MCP server won Anthropic's MCP hackathon. Missing for 10: detailed MCP server install/configuration documentation in the evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP server from non-maintainer users.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Give a Claude Code agent persistent Stagehand browser tools over MCP/stdio.
Each integration gives your agent one persistent browser and three tools: `run`, `snapshot`, and `screenshot`.
Control browsers using plain English commands like "click the login button" or "fill out the contact form"
Our Stagehand MCP server actually won Anthropic's Claude MCP hackathon
